patients.label: 16-year-old male judo athlete with persistent hemoptysis and a large left lower lobe cystic lesion

identity_evidence.quote: We present the case of a 16-year-old male judo athlete

attribution_limitations: The authors say judo training was likely exposing him to repeated subclinical blunt chest trauma, but no trauma event is documented.

The referral sentence mentions abnormal findings on chest radiography and CT without details; the source does not say these are the same studies as the initial chest X-ray and the contrast-enhanced CT described afterwards.

The case text says the lesion was excised with an endoscopic stapler, and the abstract and discussion say a wedge resection was performed and accomplished with endo-staplers; they are recorded as one resection because the discussion links the chosen wedge resection to the endo-stapler resection and only one resection is described.
The CT is described as a hydropneumothorax in the case text and as a cystic lesion with an air-fluid level in the Figure 1 caption; the source does not call these a conflict.
